The Subtask Name: Determine the directors of the films and their death dates

Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Conducted internet searches to identify the directors of the films and their death dates.
  -- Observation: Browsed through multiple sources including Wikipedia, IMDb, and other film databases.
  -- Thought: Needed to verify the exact titles and directors of the films to ensure accurate information.
  -- Result: Identified the directors as Don Sharp for "The Face of Fu Manchu" and Roberto Gavaldón for "The Hidden One," and retrieved their death dates.

- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched for the death dates of the identified directors.
  -- Observation: Accessed obituaries and official records to gather accurate death information.
  -- Thought: Ensured the information was reliable and consistent across multiple sources.
  -- Result: Determined the death dates of Don Sharp (December 14, 2011) and Roberto Gavaldón (September 4, 1986).
